create_unity_t2u_model: create a UnitY T2U model from a configuration with optional device and data type
build_autoregressive_model: build an autoregressive UnitYT2U model using UnitYT2UBuilder with encoder, decoder, and embedding layers
build_nar_model: build a non-autoregressive UnitYNART2U model with variance adaptor, prosody projection, and NAR decoder frontend
configure_base_t2u_arch: configure a base UnitY T2U architecture with 6 encoder/decoder layers and 1024 model dimension
configure_expressivity_nar: configure an expressivity NAR UnitY T2U architecture with FiLM conditioning and prosody projection
